resources.string: Three short pages. Each step checks itself, and you can keep using the app while things download.
The AI reads each new job, moves the ones you don’t want to Filtered out and scores your resume against the rest. The download takes a while, so start it first; you can go on meanwhile.
Tell JobFinder where to look, and sign in to those sites so your searches see every job.
Optional. With the JobFinder Android app your jobs show on your phone, and it tells you about new ones, while it’s on this computer’s Wi-Fi.
Already signed in to these sites in your own Chrome or Edge? With the extension connected, copy those sign-ins instead. Google sign-in works either way.
This computer is ready. JobFinder checks your searches on the schedule in Settings.
Signed in to the job sites
This computer isn’t on Wi-Fi or a cable. Connect it to the network your phone uses.
Another program uses JobFinder’s port. Choose another port in Settings.
Windows treats this network as Public, which hides the computer from phones.
The firewall has no rule for JobFinder yet, so phones can’t reach it.
A firewall rule blocks JobFinder. Fixing it removes that rule.
Windows asked for permission and the answer was No. Try again and choose Yes.
Ollama runs the AI on this computer. It isn’t installed yet.
Ollama is installed but not running.
Ollama couldn’t be installed. Check the internet connection and try again.
Add a search first. Then this opens the sites it uses so you can sign in.
The download stopped. Try again; it carries on where it stopped.
Opens the sites your searches use in Chrome or Edge, one tab each, so searches see every job. Sign in, then close that browser.
Sign in on every tab, then close the browser. JobFinder keeps the sign-ins when it closes.
Search on any job board (LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri or another), copy the link of the results page and add it in Searches. JobFinder checks it for new jobs.

Optional, for Chrome or Edge: shows the ATS score on saved jobs, fills application forms, reads pages the app can’t open and shares your sign-ins. Add it to JobFinder’s own browser, where you signed in to the job sites, or to your everyday one: open its extensions page, turn on Developer mode, choose Load unpacked and pick the extension folder.
On the phone, open JobFinder and pick %1$s.
On the phone, open JobFinder and pick %1$s, or scan this code.
About %1$s to download, once. It runs on this computer; nothing you send it leaves it.
%1$s opened with JobFinder’s profile. %2$s is copied: paste it into the address bar to open the extensions page.
%1$s opened with JobFinder’s profile. Type %2$s into its address bar to open the extensions page.
JobFinder’s browser did not open. Install Chrome or Edge, or add the extension to your own browser.
Ask Windows once for permission to set the network to Private and open the firewall for phones on this network.
Download and install Ollama. On Linux, your computer asks for your password once.
Download the AI model, about %1$s. Keep the computer on until it’s done.
How this computer runs the AI
This computer: %1$s GB memory, %2$s GB on the graphics card.
Offline first. The AI runs on this computer: free, private and fast. Free online keys are optional.
Offline first, with help. The AI runs here, but part of it doesn’t fit on the graphics card and runs slower on the processor. Add free online keys for job pages on busy days; your resume stays here.
Online first. This computer fits only a smaller model, which misses more good jobs. Free online keys read the job pages; this computer is the backup and keeps your resume.

Online first. This computer can’t run a good AI model: it needs at least 4 GB on the graphics card and 8 GB memory. Use free online keys for job pages, and pick an online model in Settings → AI → Main model for resume work.
Get free keys, most free use first, then paste them in Settings → AI → Free online keys.
Find job boards with an AI assistant
Copy the request, paste it into Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT or another assistant and attach your resume. It suggests search pages for your skills; paste its answer here to add them as searches.
The assistant’s answer (one “Title | link” per line)
Write your AI filter with an assistant
The assistant asks what you want, then writes the description of jobs to skip and the companies to skip. Paste its answer here to save it in AI filters.
The request includes what JobFinder’s ATS check found in your resume. Save the assistant’s new resume as a file and pick it in Settings → Resume, then check its ATS scores.
Added %1$d searches. %2$d links were not search pages JobFinder can read; they are still in the box.
Saved your AI filter, with %1$d more companies to skip.
Nothing in the answer could be used. Paste the assistant’s whole answer.
That didn’t work. Check that the app is running and try again.
